description: Cs₂NaCo(CN)₆ crystallizes in the monoclinic P2₁/c space group. Cs is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to three N atoms. There are a spread of Cs-N bond distances ranging from 3.30-3.40 Å. Na is bonded in an octahedral geometry to six N atoms. There are a spread of Na-N bond distances ranging from 2.46-2.49 Å. Co is bonded in an octahedral geometry to six C atoms. All Co-C bond lengths are 1.88 Å. There are three inequivalent C sites. In the first C site, C is bonded in a linear geometry to one Co and one N atom. The C-N bond length is 1.18 Å. In the second C site, C is bonded in a linear geometry to one Co and one N atom. The C-N bond length is 1.18 Å. In the third C site, C is bonded in a linear geometry to one Co and one N atom. The C-N bond length is 1.18 Å. There are three inequivalent N sites. In the first N site, N is bonded in a 2-coordinate geometry to one Cs, one Na, and one C atom. In the second N site, N is bonded in a 2-coordinate geometry to one Cs, one Na, and one C atom. In the third N site, N is bonded in a distorted bent 150 degrees geometry to one Cs, one Na, and one C atom.
